name: Keeta Network MCP Server
description: Provides AI agents with native access to the Keeta Network Layer 1 blockchain for payments, asset transfers, and compliance-ready financial infrastructure. It features a dynamic, self-describing architecture that allows agents to automatically discover and execute SDK methods at runtime.
